title: Implement MARBLE TaskChain dependency tracker and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task TaskChain (task_id=46 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-325/solution.py per assets/gc-325/SPEC.md: a dependency-aware task tracker with cycle rejection, readiness gating, an ordered event feed, and delay reporting. Plan the data model (graph, statuses, events) before coding, implement in verified increments, and run the sealed acceptance suite after each increment, recording which named tests remain red. Every red run must be answered by a targeted fix and a re-run; finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-325/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that names the graph representation and the cycle-detection approach
The sealed suite was executed at least twice with logs retained: an early red run and the final green run
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; recovery happens only in workspace/gc-325/solution.py
